name: Medetashi Medetashi made
original_name: めでたしめでたしまで
source:
Play the role of an ordinary main character in the story—a nameless cat. He journeys through the pages of the book in search of the heroine's secret.

A game in which the author creatively manipulates the template of the main character. It invites players to assume the role of a mob cat within a whimsical atmosphere of various fairy tales. Even the characters, who lack individual names, are memorable due to their distinct personalities and roles in the narrative.

In the course of the story, you will encounter puzzles of varying difficulty. The most intriguing aspect is that while solving these puzzles, you can truly engage with the world and its characters. Additionally, there are a few hidden secrets to discover. Although the game appears simple and straightforward, it manages to raise interesting questions about loneliness, trust and self-expression.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624330/Medetashi_Medetashi/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演故事中一名普通的角色——一只没有名字的猫。它穿行于书页之间，寻找女主角的秘密。

本作巧妙地改变了传统主角的设定，让玩家化身一只不起眼的猫，走进充满奇思妙想的童话氛围。即使角色没有各自的名字，鲜明的个性与故事中的定位，也足以让人印象深刻。

故事中，你将遇到难度各异的谜题。最有趣的是，解谜的同时，你也能真正与这个世界和其中的角色互动。此外，还有一些隐藏的秘密等你发现。游戏看似简单直接，却探讨了孤独、信任与自我表达等值得思考的问题。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624330/Medetashi_Medetashi/]Steam[/url]]
